benchmark: W3 minimal benchmark (judge.py), track U strict-UI
driver: smartcli_core.PtySession directly (WinptyBackend/ConPTY); the drive-tui CLI is not installed on this box (`where drive-tui` -> nothing)
pty_concurrency: episodes run SEQUENTIALLY, one PTY at a time, each session closed before the next
note: fixture pre-state (the 2-line temp file / the absent target) and the ground-truth reads are recorded OUTSIDE the per-episode `actions` list: `actions` holds only what was done through the PTY during the episode, which is what track U constrains.
